statements.quote: Event term: Sudden cardiac death Onset: 2026-05-19
statements.text: The EDC records a serious adverse event of sudden cardiac death with onset and end date 2026-05-19, seriousness criterion death, outcome fatal and severity severe.

statements.quote: ae id: AE-004, ae term: Myocardial infarction
statements.text: The EDC lists an earlier event, AE-004 myocardial infarction, with onset date 2026-05-17.
The subject was a 77-year-old man with ongoing hypertension since 2018, and amlodipine was recorded as a concomitant medication from 2024-11-01.

statements.quote: admitted on 17/05/2026 with an acute anterior
statements.text: The subject was admitted to the Coronary Care Unit on 17/05/2026 with an acute anterior myocardial infarction.
The admission troponin T was recorded as 2950 ng/L.

statements.quote: developed cardiogenic shock requiring inotropic support
statements.text: On 18/05/2026 the subject developed cardiogenic shock requiring inotropic support, and TIMI flow grade 0 was seen in the left anterior descending artery.

statements.quote: ventricular fibrillation arrest. Resuscitation was unsuccessful
statements.text: On 19/05/2026 at 03:40 the subject had a ventricular fibrillation arrest, resuscitation was unsuccessful, and death was confirmed at 04:15.

statements.quote: Cause of death: 1a cardiogenic shock, 1b acute anterior myocardial infarction.
statements.text: The death summary conclusion gives the cause of death as cardiogenic shock (1a) and acute anterior myocardial infarction (1b), and the death was reported to the coroner.
